D1.description: Root directory has 10 or fewer meaningful entries

D2.description: Every workspace or package has a one-line purpose statement

D3.description: Source, test, config, and generated directories are segregated

D4.description: No utility dumping ground files (utils.ts, helpers.ts, misc.ts, common.ts)

D5.description: Directory depth does not exceed 5 levels before a module boundary

B1.description: No circular imports between packages or workspaces

B2.description: Shared code lives in a declared shared package

B3.description: Each package or workspace declares a public API surface (index.ts)

B4.description: UI primitives and application logic are in separate locations

B5.description: Test files mirror source structure or are co-located

C1.description: Generated artifacts are excluded from the source tree

C3.description: No file imports from more than 15 distinct modules

C4.description: High fan-in files (10+ dependents) are documented

C5.description: Import graph depth does not exceed 8 hops from entry to leaf

C6.description: Entry files expose a local boundary surface before infrastructure

O1.description: A machine-readable guidance file exists (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, clarx-manifest.json)

O4.description: Guidance file declares where common changes belong

E1.description: No multi-purpose controller or route files exceeding 300 lines

E2.description: Related files are co-located or grouped predictably

E3.description: No utility file exports more than 20 unrelated functions

E4.description: Package boundaries are enforced by tooling

E5.description: Each package has a single declared entry point

confidenceLevels.high: Manifest file, full import graph, and filesystem all available
confidenceLevels.medium: Filesystem and partial import graph available
